text: 今晚美联储加息似乎已毫无悬念，但市场面对的可能不止“加息”这个词！四大央行同时收紧，更难应付的行情恐还在后头，这次“落锤”会否带出一系列问题？<font class="important-text"></font>
text_en: Tonight's Fed rate hike seems a foregone conclusion, but the market may face more than just the word "hike"! With four major central banks tightening simultaneously, harder-to-handle market conditions may still lie ahead. Will this "hammer drop" trigger a series of problems?<font class="important-text"></font>
